relationships.subject: Bt354
relationships.evidence_quote: Intrathecal administration of Bt354 significantly reduced CCI-induced mechanical allodynia and thermal hyperalgesia

relationships.subject: Bt354
relationships.evidence_quote: Bt354 inhibited the nuclear translocation of neuronal pSTAT3

relationships.subject: Bt354
relationships.evidence_quote: Collectively, the pSTAT3 inhibitor mitigated CCI-induced upregulation of the neuronal NLRP3 inflammasome in the ipsilateral SCDH.

relationships.subject: Bt354
relationships.evidence_quote: Bt354 effectively attenuated CCI-induced activation of the neuronal LDHA/pTBK1/NLRP3 pathway in ipsilateral SCDH

relationships.subject: Bt354
relationships.evidence_quote: In general, Bt354 alleviated CCI-driven nuclear pCREB expression in microglia in the ipsilateral SCDH.

key_findings: Intrathecal STAT3 inhibitor Bt354 (ED50 1.176 ug) reduced CCI-induced allodynia/hyperalgesia and spinal pSTAT3, which is predominantly neuronal.
Bt354 reduced M1 microglia and A1 astrocyte polarization, neuronal NLRP3 and LDHA/pTBK1, and microglial pCREB.
